The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -1.518795, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas used for the 'statistics' matrix are either referencing non-existent functions or contain syntax errors that Excel/openpyxl cannot resolve.
